units.source_text: 只可惜那小虫逃走了，大概自己有些兴奋过了头，再加上斑蝥的飞行路线含含糊糊看不清楚。

en.t: Unfortunately, the little insect got away, probably because he himself had become a bit too excited, and because the blister beetle's flight path was vague and hard to make out.

units.source_text: 逃跑时，它老是回过头来等着，简直像在说，来呀，来抓我呀。

en.t: As it fled, it kept turning back and waiting, almost as if it were saying, come on, come catch me.

units.source_text: 等你相信它，一靠近，它又嗤地飞起来，又回过头来等着。

en.t: Once you trusted it and drew close, it would take off again with a faint hiss, then turn back and wait once more.

units.source_text: 直到把追逐者弄得厌烦透顶，最后，它嚓地消失在草丛里。

en.t: Only after it had bored its pursuer to exhaustion did it finally vanish with a quick rustle into the grass.
